title: Build a Rover Family
story: ION: The second assembly wing needs production-grade Python. Restore the machine, then inspect its diagnostics with O.
objective: Define Rover(name), storing self.name. SurveyRover and CargoRover must inherit Rover. Each implements report() returning {"name": self.name, "role": "survey"} or role "cargo". Instances must keep independent names.
lesson: Inheritance shares construction; polymorphism gives different implementations of the same report() method.
